subtasks.description: Add `archived_at` column (nullable TEXT) to the `tasks` table in src/db/schema.sql using an idempotent ALTER TABLE guard (no-op if column already exists — SQLite has no IF NOT EXISTS for columns, so wrap in a try/catch in DbClient.initSchema or use a PRAGMA table_info check). Update the `task_outcomes` view if needed so archived tasks remain countable. Extend `PipelineTask` in src/types/core.ts with an optional `archivedAt?: string` field, and update `DbClient.listTasks()` and `DbClient.getTask()` in src/db/client.ts to read/return this field.
testCriteria: Running the server against an existing DB does not throw; `archived_at` column is present on `tasks` after initSchema
A fresh DB created from schema.sql has the `archived_at` column as nullable TEXT
`DbClient.listTasks()` returns each task with an `archivedAt` field (string or undefined)
`DbClient.getTask(id)` returns `archivedAt` for an archived row and undefined for a non-archived row

subtasks.description: Add three methods to DbClient (src/db/client.ts): `archiveTask(taskId)` sets `archived_at = datetime('now')` and `updated_at` on the task row, `unarchiveTask(taskId)` sets `archived_at = NULL`, and `deleteTaskPermanently(taskId)` removes the task and all dependent rows in a single transaction (tasks, subtasks WHERE task_id, review_findings WHERE task_id, events WHERE task_id, agent_transcripts WHERE task_id, routing_calibration WHERE task_id). Each method throws a clear Error if the task does not exist. `deleteTaskPermanently` must only succeed when the task is currently archived — throw otherwise, so delete is always a two-step action. Add a unit test file tests/db-archive.test.ts covering all three methods including the 'delete requires archived' guard.
testCriteria: archiveTask sets archived_at to a non-null ISO-ish timestamp; listTasks returns that value
unarchiveTask clears archived_at back to undefined
deleteTaskPermanently removes the task row plus all subtasks, events, review_findings, agent_transcripts, routing_calibration for that task in one transaction
deleteTaskPermanently throws when the task is not archived and leaves all rows intact
All three methods throw a descriptive Error when the taskId does not exist
tests/db-archive.test.ts passes via `bun test tests/db-archive.test.ts`

subtasks.description: Add archive/unarchive/delete methods to OrchestratorService (src/orchestrator/service.ts): `archiveTask(taskId)`, `unarchiveTask(taskId)`, `deleteTaskPermanently(taskId)`. `archiveTask` must only be allowed when the task is in a terminal state (`completed` or `failed`) — throw otherwise (active tasks must be cancelled first). On archive, also call cleanupWorktree defensively (no-op if already removed). Each method records an orchestrator event (`task_archived`, `task_unarchived`, `task_deleted`) with minimal payload via recordEvent so the event log preserves history — except `deleteTaskPermanently`, which should record the `task_deleted` event BEFORE the DB delete transaction, then run the delete (which will also cascade-delete that event — acceptable; the point is transparent behaviour, not audit trail). Update `listTasks()` signature to accept an optional filter: `listTasks(opts?: { includeArchived?: boolean; onlyArchived?: boolean })`; default behavior excludes archived tasks. Thread the same option through DbClient.listTasks.
testCriteria: archiveTask throws when task is in a non-terminal state (e.g. 'executing')
archiveTask succeeds for 'completed' and 'failed' tasks and marks archived_at
unarchiveTask restores the task to the active list
deleteTaskPermanently throws when task is not archived; succeeds when archived
listTasks() by default excludes archived tasks
listTasks({ includeArchived: true }) returns both; listTasks({ onlyArchived: true }) returns only archived
Existing orchestrator tests still pass

subtasks.description: Expose REST endpoints in src/web/routes/tasks.ts: `POST /:id/archive`, `POST /:id/unarchive`, `DELETE /:id` (permanent delete). Update `GET /` to accept optional query params `?archived=true` (only archived) and `?includeArchived=true` (both). Each endpoint returns the updated task JSON (or `{ ok: true }` for delete) and publishes a `task.updated` (archive/unarchive) or `task.deleted` (delete) event via the LiveEventHub so the dashboard refreshes. Map service-layer errors to appropriate HTTP codes: 404 when task missing, 409 when archive attempted on active task or delete attempted on non-archived task, 400 for other validation issues.
testCriteria: POST /tasks/:id/archive returns 200 with updated task containing archivedAt; returns 409 for active tasks; 404 for unknown id
POST /tasks/:id/unarchive returns 200 with archivedAt cleared
DELETE /tasks/:id returns 200 {ok:true} for archived tasks; 409 for non-archived; 404 for unknown id
GET /tasks defaults to active only (no archived)
GET /tasks?archived=true returns only archived tasks
GET /tasks?includeArchived=true returns all tasks
A `task.deleted` event with the taskId is published on successful delete, and `task.updated` on archive/unarchive

subtasks.description: Add UI support in src/web/public/dashboard.js, src/web/public/index.html, and src/web/public/styles.css. Render a small, minimal icon button on each task list item: for active tasks an 'Archive' button (e.g. box/archive icon or × glyph) that calls POST /tasks/:id/archive; for archived tasks a 'Restore' button and a 'Delete permanently' button (the latter shows a `confirm()` prompt before calling DELETE /tasks/:id). Add a top-level toggle/tab in the Tasks view to switch between 'Active' and 'Archived' lists (reuse the existing nav styling). Wire client state so the fetch uses `?archived=true` when on the Archived tab. Handle the SSE `task.updated` and `task.deleted` events to refresh the current list. The buttons must stop event propagation so clicking them does not open the task detail view. Keep styling minimal — a ghost/icon button variant, not a prominent CTA.
testCriteria: Each active task list item renders an archive icon button; clicking it archives the task without navigating into the detail view
An Active / Archived toggle is visible in the Tasks view and switching tabs re-fetches the corresponding list
Archived task list items render both Restore and Delete buttons
Clicking Delete shows a confirmation prompt; cancelling the prompt makes no network call; confirming calls DELETE and the item disappears from the list
SSE events update the visible list without a full page reload
Button styling is minimal (icon/ghost variant) and does not overwhelm the task row

subtasks.description: End-to-end review pass: run `bun test`, `bun run` (or equivalent type-check script in package.json), and verify the full archive → unarchive → delete flow via the HTTP API against a fresh DB. Confirm that replaying events via `DbClient.rebuildProjectionsFromEvents()` is unaffected by the new `archived_at` column (archived_at is projection state, not event-sourced — document this explicitly in a short comment in projections.ts). Update README.md with a one-paragraph 'Archiving tasks' section describing the UI and endpoints. Fix any issues surfaced.
testCriteria: `bun test` passes with no new failures
Type check / build command passes
Manual archive → unarchive → archive → delete flow succeeds end-to-end via curl against a running server
`rebuildProjectionsFromEvents()` leaves archived_at as NULL for all tasks (documented behavior) and does not throw
README has a short 'Archiving tasks' section describing the feature
